dedupe_keys.name: post disaster emergency services and resource allocation benchmark datasets

description: Post-Disaster Emergency Services and Resource Allocation Benchmark Datasets is a data set deposited in Harvard Dataverse by its authors Sehej Jain, Kusum Bharti Kumari. This dataset contains 16 files, each of which details a crisis situation with a number of emergency sites, service providers, units, and types of emergencies. The specifications of each file are attached in their metadata. This is the accompanying dataset for the publication "A Combinatorial Optimization Model for Emergency Resource Allocation after Disasters.". Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2022. Formats: JSON. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC BY 4.0. Caveats: written from the Dataverse search and dataset metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support emergency-service and public-facility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-hdv-repository.
